set.body: Found during UI-X1 close-out (2026-09-17): ContrastCsv renders the sigma column via Double.toString, which yields 1.0 on the JVM and 1 on Scala.js. StudyGuideOracleSuite compares sigma numerically so both platforms pass, but exported CSV bytes differ across runtimes. Decide on an explicit numeric rendering (fixed decimal or shortest round-trip via a shared formatter) for every Double column in io exports, pin it on both platforms, and add the byte-identity check to the cross-platform suite.
set.title: Make CSV number rendering identical on JVM and Scala.js
